recognize_zh: 單一母細胞核染色質細緻、核質比高，細胞質中可見一條細長、紅紫色的針狀包涵體（Auer rod），這是骨髓系母細胞的特徵，確立為急性骨髓性白血病的母細胞。
features: Single large blast, approximately 2 times red cell diameter, with high N:C ratio
Round to slightly irregular nucleus with finely granular, open chromatin
One slender, rod-shaped, pink-red azurophilic cytoplasmic inclusion (Auer rod) at the cell edge
Background normochromic red cells without other nucleated cells
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at high power shows a large blast with a high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, finely dispersed chromatin and a rim of pale basophilic cytoplasm. The cytoplasm contains a single slender, needle-shaped azurophilic inclusion consistent with an Auer rod. The background red cells are unremarkable. The presence of an Auer rod establishes the myeloid lineage of the blast; findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia (or high-grade myeloid neoplasm with circulating blasts).

ddx.vs: Lymphoblasts never contain Auer rods and are MPO negative.
APL cells contain bundles of multiple Auer rods and heavy azurophilic granules with bilobed nuclei, rather than a single rod in an agranular blast.

ddx.dx: Pseudo-Auer rod / platelet overlying a cell or stain artifact
ddx.vs: True Auer rods lie within the cytoplasm in the focal plane and are MPO positive, whereas overlying debris is out of plane and MPO negative.
Döhle bodies are pale blue, irregular patches in the cytoplasm of mature neutrophils, not red rods in a blast.
